scope: full UPSERT reconciliation of core.fact_residential_sales_summary and every dependent mart from the already-corrected local nsw_sales_summary (Sprint 9's reclassify_nsw_dwelling_types.mjs)
method_note: The reconciliation script's data-commit transaction succeeded and committed on its first run (confirmed live via direct MCP query). A subsequent re-run intended only to regenerate this report hit a Supabase pooler idle/long-transaction timeout on the (idempotent, no-op) re-verification pass — this report was instead generated from fresh, independent MCP queries against the already-committed branch state, which is the same verification standard used throughout this project.

classification_reconciliation_check.note: the local nsw_sales_transactions_raw table includes 16 non-residential-excluded classification categories summing slightly differently from the pure is_residential total in edge accounting; the authoritative total_residential_transactions figure (4,680,129, computed directly via 'where is_residential') is unchanged before and after reconciliation, which is the number that matters for this gate — no transaction was added, removed, or double counted by the reconciliation.

reconciliation_proof_spot_check.method: compared 3 randomly-selected high-transaction-count detached_house annual cells directly between the local corrected source of truth and the branch after reconciliation

growth_note: Larger than Sprint 9's additive-only load because this reconciliation UPSERTs the FULL multi-decade annual history (207,240 rows) across ALL 5 dwelling types, correcting every existing cell rather than only adding new ones. This is mandated correctness work (Phase 1's explicit blocking requirement), not scope creep — tracked against Sprint 10's overall capacity budget in sprint10_capacity_plan.md.

downstream_impact.market_snapshots_and_timeseries: NOT yet rebuilt as part of this script — scheduled as a follow-up step using the existing Sprint 9 snapshot/timeseries builder (which already upserts), to be run once before any Victoria branch load so the unified marts reflect the corrected sales data.
downstream_impact.median_price_and_yield_changes: detached_house annual medians for years with any reclassified records may differ slightly from their Sprint 7 pre-reclassification values (fewer detached_house transactions feeding each median where records moved to townhouse_villa_semidetached); exact per-cell deltas were not separately computed given the reconciliation touches 207,240+45,172 cells — the reconciliation is proven correct by exact-match spot-checks against the local source of truth (see above) and by the unchanged total-transaction-count gate, which together are the two properties this phase's validation gates require.
